pako 2.1.0 embedded zlib port

Primary source:
  https://github.com/nodeca/pako
  https://github.com/nodeca/pako/blob/v2.1.0/lib/zlib/README
  zlib project: https://zlib.net/

The published pako package metadata states that the root package is MIT AND
Zlib, and its README states that /lib/zlib is under the zlib license.  The
pako 2.1.0 README identifies that JavaScript port as based on zlib 1.2.8 and
attributes the port contributions to Vitaly Puzrin and Andrey Tupitsin.  The
Herdr bundle embeds pako's zlib modules through ag-psd's published bundle.
The existing vendor/PAKO-LICENSE.txt preserves pako's MIT notice; this file
preserves the additional zlib notice required by the actual bundled closure.

The pako zlib README says this port is under the zlib license, with the
JavaScript-port contributions under the Expat/MIT terms in the package root.
The root package terms are preserved in vendor/PAKO-LICENSE.txt.

Pako port copyrights:
(C) 1995-2013 Jean-loup Gailly and Mark Adler
(C) 2014-2017 Vitaly Puzrin and Andrey Tupitsin


From zlib's README

Acknowledgments:

  The deflate format used by zlib was defined by Phil Katz.  The deflate and
  zlib specifications were written by L. Peter Deutsch.  Thanks to all the
  people who reported problems and suggested various improvements to zlib;
  they are too numerous to cite here.
